\begin{example} \end{example}[Minimal Surface Equation]

↗ def:kth-order-pde ↗ def:linear-semilinear-quasilinear-fully-nonlinear

1. ch1:1.2.1.b.4\group Examples of PDE

\[ \Div \left(\frac{Du}{(1+|Du|^2)^{1/2}}\right) = 0. \] For a classical solution, an equivalent form is \[ (1+|Du|^2)^{-1/2}\Delta u - (1+|Du|^2)^{-3/2}D^2u(Du,Du) = 0, \] and the equation is second-order quasilinear. \end{example}
